title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can store attacker-controlled certificate values. When another user with access to the Secure Sockets Layer Search dashboard selects an affected row, the system may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the permissions of the selecting user. This occurs because the dashboard encodes certificate values for drilldown links but does not properly escape them as SPL search literals. This flaw can lead to unauthorized data access and modification by the user who initially stored the malicious values.
